source.quote: The costs incurred during the year in respect of these employees were: 2025 2024 2023 $m $m $m Wages and salaries 10,974 10,340 9,341 Social security costs 1,348 1,224 1,100 Pension costs 618 614 537 Other employment costs 1,608 1,531 1,357 Total 14,548 13,709 12,335

notes: Employees: year-end head count from Note 29 (the monthly average was 95,100, including part-time employees). Payroll: Note 29's total employee costs for 2025 ($14,548 million: wages and salaries $10,974 million, social security $1,348 million, pensions $618 million, other $1,608 million). Severance costs of $190 million are not included in that total, and the share-based payment charge ($719 million) is reported separately.
